jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-operations match with day-to-day operational ownership, staff coordination, service delivery, and process management in a major health system. Kevin’s healthcare operations, intake, training, and workflow experience transfer directly.
jobs.gap: The role sits within a hospital/cardiology environment, so Kevin should be ready to explain how his ambulatory/ABA operations experience transfers to a larger clinical setting.

jobs.title: Operations Manager / Practice Manager - Concierge Primary Care
jobs.why: Strong practice-operations fit across patient experience, office workflows, team coordination, and operational excellence. Kevin’s family-facing healthcare operations and systems/process work create a credible transition into practice management.
jobs.gap: Private Medical asks for substantial direct practice-management experience. Kevin should emphasize operational ownership, staff training, intake workflows, escalation handling, and measurable process improvements.

jobs.title: Assistant Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare operations role with strong overlap in administrative workflows, coordination, reporting, training, and process execution inside a major academic medical center.
jobs.gap: The salary band starts below Kevin’s target, and the role may prefer prior academic-medical-center experience. It remains viable because the posted range reaches above $120K.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong business-operations match focused on operational performance, staffing, planning, and cross-functional execution. Kevin’s systems, process-improvement, reporting, and project-management background aligns well with the operating-partner nature of the role.
jobs.gap: STV operates in program and construction management, so industry context is the main gap. Kevin should emphasize transferable operating systems, workforce coordination, metrics, and process design.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: High-upside business-operations role in a growth company where process design, cross-functional execution, analytics, and scalable operating systems are central. Kevin’s automation and systems-operations experience make this a worthwhile stretch.
jobs.gap: The compensation and growth-stage environment suggest a high bar for strategic analytics and startup operating experience. Kevin should keep SQL positioned as foundational/working knowledge and lead with automation, CRM, dashboards, and execution.

jobs.title: Talent Operations Program Manager, Systems & Insights
jobs.why: Strong systems-and-program-operations match across workflow design, recruiting operations, systems, metrics, process governance, and operational consistency. Kevin’s recruiting, onboarding, training, and automation background is highly transferable.
jobs.gap: This is talent operations rather than healthcare or core business operations, so Kevin should position his recruiting and onboarding systems work as the primary bridge.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Program Manager, Central Operations
jobs.why: Strong program-operations opportunity centered on scalable execution, cross-functional programs, operating systems, and process improvement in a technology marketplace. Kevin’s workflow, project, and systems background maps well to the core work.
jobs.gap: The senior level and marketplace-scale operating environment are stretch factors. Kevin should foreground end-to-end initiative ownership, stakeholder coordination, reporting, and measurable process improvements.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Workforce Training Programs
jobs.why: Excellent overlap with training operations, workforce development, program management, stakeholder coordination, and building repeatable training processes. Kevin’s staff-training and recruiting experience is especially relevant.
jobs.gap: The role is workforce-development focused rather than healthcare operations, and the compensation ceiling is close to the minimum target. Kevin should emphasize training program ownership and operational execution.

jobs.title: Benefits Operations Manager
jobs.why: Remote operations role at an automation-focused software company with strong overlap in process design, systems, vendor coordination, documentation, and scalable operational support.
jobs.gap: Benefits administration is a specialized domain. Kevin should position his systems/process strengths clearly and avoid implying direct benefits-domain depth he does not have.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.why: Interesting healthcare-adjacent remote operations role involving program operations, leadership, call-center operations, and CMS healthcare-policy context. Kevin’s healthcare operations and workflow-management experience are relevant.
jobs.gap: Federal/CMS program experience and large call-center operations may be preferred. The range also starts just under $100K, although the upper end comfortably exceeds the target.
